subject: QBR prep: Executive synopsis, healthscore roundup & renewal triage
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: Executive synopsis, healthscore roundup & renewal triage

Team — kicking off a short thread to align on QBR asks for Arbor Health (renewal in 9 wks). I pulled the healthscore snapshot and a draft of the renewal-risk register; attaching excerpts. Key points up-front:

- Healthscore: 62/100 (declined 11 pts over last quarter driven by latency spikes and two incidents in Apr)
- Top risks: production latency (SRE mitigation ongoing), delayed procurement signature, and one integration bug in their ingestion pipeline
- Commercial: expansion ask from Arbor's data science team paused pending performance SLA confirmation

Immediate asks for execs (Vivek/Laura):
1) Exec attention: a one-paragraph brief we can hand to Arbor execs summarizing remediation plan and offer of credits/short-term SLA.
2) Authorization: approve up to a 10% one-time credit for incident impact if we go that route (will be tied to signed renewal commitment).
3) Escalation: confirm whether Sales should request a private exec call (Vivek) or route through CS leadership (Laura).

Attachments: 2027-05-28_Arbor_healthscore_snapshot.xlsx (TAB: trend + root cause notes), renewal-risk-register_excerpt.pdf (summary).

Notes: I recommend highlighting the mitigation timeline (SRE + runtime team) and offer a temporary dedicated capacity pilot for a month as a trust-building measure. If approved, I will draft the exec brief and coordinate a DocuSign amendment.

Thanks — Ol
--
Olga Petrov

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Executive synopsis, healthscore roundup & renewal triage

Thanks Olga — good, concise summary. A few quick directions:

- Exec brief: Yes, I want a single-sheet summary (one page) aimed at Arbor CTO + VP Eng. Focus on what happened, what we fixed, and what we'll do in next 30 days (specific owners & dates). Keep it non-technical at the top, then one callout box with technical details.
- Credits: I approve up to 8% credit tied to a 12-month renewal commitment. Don't offer more than that without finance sign-off. If they push back, we can escalate to finance for a special exception.
- Dedicated pilot: I like the idea, but it must be timeboxed and measurable. Approval contingent on a short SOW (30 days), pre-defined SLOs, and an explicit escalation path.

Please draft the one-pager and loop in Brandon in Finance for credit language. Laura — can you confirm expected remediation ETA for the ingestion bug and latency fixes? I want dates for the brief.

-Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP of Revenue & Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Executive synopsis, healthscore roundup & renewal triage

On Fri, May 28, 2027 at 08:12 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — kicking off a short thread to align on QBR asks for Arbor Health (renewal in 9 wks). I pulled the healthscore snapshot and a draft of the renewal-risk register; attaching excerpts. Key points up-front:

Thanks — added some concrete remediation details below. ETA and owners:

- Ingestion bug: root cause identified (edge-case schema mismatch). Hotfix built and in canary now. ETA full rollout: 2027-06-03. Owner: Priya Natarajan (Integrations PM).
- Latency spikes: mitigation plan in place; rolling out model-level batching/kv-cache tuning and a temporary scale bump. ETA: measurable reduction within 7 days; full stability in 21 days. Owner: Karthik Iyer (Runtime SRE).
- Customer communication: recommend proactive note with timeline + offer of weekly check-ins until renewal.

I attached the excerpted renewal-risk register with row-level comments (see renewal-risk-register_excerpt.pdf) and a summary workbook (2027-05-28_Arbor_healthscore_snapshot.xlsx). I'll add Priya & Karthik to the working doc for technical detail.

As for credits: I will add language that ties credit to a signed renewal and to the remediation milestones; that should make it palatable to Finance.

Laura

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Enterprise

Vivek/Laura — thanks for the quick responses. Next steps I will execute today:

1) Draft 1-page exec brief for Arbor CTO/VP Eng (Olga) — target: 2027-05-28 EOD PST. Will include remediation timeline, owner commitments, and pilot offer language.
2) Draft credit memo (Olga -> Brandon in Finance) with proposed 8% credit conditioned on 12-month renewal + milestone completion.
3) Schedule a short pre-QBR sync (30 min) with Arbor execs — proposing 2027-06-07 or 2027-06-09. Will share two time options.

Looping in Daniel at Arbor so he sees the plan. Daniel — appreciate your patience; Laura's team will provide weekly status notes until renewal is signed.

If anyone objects to the above, please reply now. Otherwise I'll proceed and share the draft brief when ready.

Thanks — Ol
